preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of practice matches Rayne has played is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.
The number of goals scored in each practice match is between 0 and 1000000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'UNFIT' or a non-negative integer representing the maximum goal difference that Rayne can show.
